title: AFTER command comparison rules, version 1
description: The single fixed command policy accepted by the current comparator. This is not a user-extensible rule language.

const.exit_status: exact Docker container exit status; statuses >=125 are incomplete
const.stdout: exact bytes or definition-declared structural JSON
const.stderr: exact bytes or definition-declared structural JSON
const.json: exact decimal values, object key order ignored, arrays ordered, null distinct from missing; reject duplicate keys and invalid Unicode
